mapper.select: select user_id, phone_number, password, school_id, student_id, campus_card, balance, created_at from users where phone_number = #{phoneNumber}

select t.type, t.amount, t.description, t.transaction_time, t.status from ( select 'recharge' as type, r.amount as amount, '账户充值' as description, r.recharge_time as transaction_time, 'success' as status, r.record_id as biz_id from recharge_records r where r.user_id = #{userId} union all select 'payment' as type, -p.amount as amount, '洗衣服务消费' as description, p.paid_at as transaction_time, 'success' as status, p.payment_id as biz_id from payments p where p.user_id = #{userId} and p.status = #{paymentStatus} ) t order by t.transaction_time desc, t.type desc, t.biz_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select (select count(*) from recharge_records where user_id = #{userId}) + (select count(*) from payments where user_id = #{userId} and status = #{paymentStatus})
